label: Copy phase: input is a fed-back 3/t/j/v/u/c/e, strongest early in long sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (t > L). It never fires on original-phase or delimiter steps, or on recall_idx 0. Almost all activity (93% of mass) is on steps whose fed-back input token is one of 3, t, j, v, u, c, e, with 3 and t the strongest (lift 7-8x). But only about 9% of such steps are active, so precision is low. Activation is more likely and larger when the token being output is also in that set (c, 3, v, j, u), at recall_idx 2-4 (peak at 3, i.e. t = 11-12), and when L is 8-9. Top examples are runs like u j v c and t v, early in the copy of 9-token sequences. Adding these conditions raises precision to about 0.4 but costs recall, and no predicate I tried got F1 above 0.35. Rarely fires on other inputs such as o, n, x, 1, 2.
